definitions.explanation: A short letter sent together with documents or a parcel, saying what is enclosed and why. In job hunting it is the covering note that goes with a mailed résumé.

examples.japanese: {添|そ}え{状|じょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{添|そ}え{状|じょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける。
examples.english: You enclose a cover letter with your résumé.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{郵送|ゆうそう}→郵送：03176_yuusou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧な{添|そ}え{状|じょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧だ。
examples.english: When you mail documents, it is good manners to include a short accompanying note.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧ (to attach, to add) + ⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧ (letter). A Japanese cover letter is short and formulaic: a greeting, a list of what is enclosed, and a closing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {添|そ}え{状|じょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける: to enclose a cover letter
- {添|そ}え{状|じょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{同封|どうふう}→同封：16367_doufuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to enclose a covering note

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{送付状|そうふじょう}→送付状：26369_soufujou⟧: transmittal sheet — a business form listing what is sent
- ⟦{送|おく}り{状|じょう}→送り状：20280_okurijou⟧: shipping slip; invoice — also used for a covering note sent with goods
